Finance, Banking and Accounting with 13.5 years of postgraduate experience in Credit Risk Management, Stakeholder management, Reference Data and Asset Management. Previous positions include Sr. Financial Analyst in Fund Accounting Pricing and Reporting at Northern Trust, Bangalore, and Jr. Analyst in Finance Operations at Coface India Credit Management, Bangalore. Recognized reliability and comprehensive leadership qualities. Possess excellent verbal and written communication skills. Committed to continuous learning and approaching every opportunity with a positive attitude. Seeking a challenging role with a reputable organization to utilize skills, explore potential, and achieve both job satisfaction and steady career growth.

raw_sections.experience:
Work History
Sr. Business Analyst (Jan 2026-May 2026) ANSI Solutions ● Company Overview: ANSI is an outsourcing start up
firm that includes tech staffing and staff augmentation to fulfill customer needs
Analysis of Financial services in detail by Bloomberg tool and stakeholder management
Creating BRD’S and FSD’S based on the transition of the projects
Preparing KPI’s and monthly Dashboards ● Conducting workshops during client visit. ● Working on Capital Markets, Reference Data and Credit Insurance
Sr. Business Analyst (Nov 2019- Oct 2025) Tech Mahindra Limited ● Company Overview: Tech Mahindra Limited is an Indian multinational subsidiary of the Mahindra Group, providing (IT) services and Business Process Outsourcing to companies in various vertical and horizontal markets
Worked on Credit-risk, Capital Markets, Asset Management, Fund accounting, Investment Banking and Custody services
Associated with Onsite Project Transition of Asset Management at IDS GmbH, Munich
Involved in documentation of Standard Operating Procedures of Asset Management Services
Application of SQL languages for BAU activities ● Analysis of Financial services in detail by Bloomberg tool, Refinitiv and IDS
Conducted requirement workshops and
collaborated with cross-regional teams for solution design.
Worked on tools like Informatica, WinSCP, Remedy, and QIS to streamline operations.
Knowledge of OTC Based products and currently working in Investment Accounting Data Services ● Worked on Visio and other process related tools ● Creating BRD’S based on the transition of the projects
Sr. Analyst (Dec 2014- April 2019) Northern Trust India Pvt Ltd., Bangalore ● Company Overview: Northern Trust Corporation is a financial services company and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois that caters to corporations, institutional investors, and high net worth individuals
Responsible for evaluating the funds in relationship with fixed income securities, Equity, CFD's, Mutual fund, Warrants and P-Notes
Utilization of various applications for trading like Bloomberg, Interactive Data, Reuters and other applications
Handling requests / queries from clients or Fund accountants with regard to the fixed income securities, equity, CFD's, Mutual fund & Corporate Actions
Coordinate with team members and ensure achievement of all team objectives and goals ● Conflict Management and handling escalations ● Analyze all issues of internal and external clients and provide effective resolutions for the same
Experience in transition of Fund Accounting Process of different Location
Knowledge & working Experience in Fund Board Reporting
Jr. Service Analyst (Aug 2013-June 2014) Coface India Credit Mgmt. Pvt Ltd., Bangalore ● Company Overview: Over 70 years of experience and the most finely meshed international network have made Coface a reference in credit insurance, risk management and the global economy
Follow up and co-ordinate with the clients for providing required information to carry out the scoring assignment
Analyzing various risks based on quantitative and qualitative information
Recommend a score to the firm which will be valid for a firm
Based on a score assigned, the underwriter will take up a decision on premium and limit for credit insurance
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines – with clear direction and support from Manager ● Contribute to the ongoing process improvements and transformation agenda across the business
Established reliable &growth-oriented process documentation by communications & knowledge transfers with Company employee
